title: Detection False-Positive Rate by Camera
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=frigate:event
| stats sum(eval(if(false_positive="true",1,0))) as fps, count as events by camera
| eval fp_rate=round(100*fps/events,1)
| sort - fp_rate
description: Measures how often each camera raises a false detection so you can tune the noisy ones instead of ignoring all alerts.
value: A camera that cries wolf trains you to ignore it; a false-positive rate shows exactly which needs zone or threshold tuning.
implementation: Label reviewed detections as true or false; schedule weekly and rank cameras by false-positive rate.
visualization: Bar chart of false-positive rate by camera.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how often each camera raises a false alarm, so you can fix the annoying ones and trust the rest.
